naive_reproducibility.note: Two independent naive-LLM runs give slightly different τ_r (273.0 vs 273.4 ns). Same systematic 1.4% offset on k_F (LLM keeps picking the simplified Strickler-Berg form). ChemMaster path is deterministic — same Python formula = same answer every time.
